newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ebro 9 mth to June net profit up 38 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ebro 9 mth to June net profit up 38 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish sugar producer Ebro Agricolas for the nine months to June 1997 (in billions of pesetas, unless stated):
Sugar business net profit 4.25 up 20 pct
Rice business net profit 1.64 vs n.a.

NOTE - Ebro said in a statement the growth in results was partly the result of a restructuring move to improve industrial production costs and its Plan 97 aimed at improving cultivation techniques and sugar beet quality.

On its rice business, after a lack of water in the growing regions of Andalusia and Extremadura for some years, its Herba unit has rebound, securing a 10 percent increase in sales of 41 billion pesetas, and a net profit of 1.64 billion pesetas.
Ebro said the outlook for the rice business for the coming years was positive.
Ebro's financial year goes from October to October.
